Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92585 AC 1, AC 11 · “Email Tasks button/functionality is confirmed absent, not just unused”.

Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S24 Human review: the task screen matches the prototype minus Email Tasks, and Email Tasks is gone as functionality, not just hidden

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 'Email Tasks' is absent from the task screen: the button and the functionality, not just unused (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U7 The task list can be sent to another signed-in app user (an NP or covering physician) in-app only, through the Handoff delivery (same recipient picker, same in-app delivery), never by email (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr; TFA-92586 ready for pr

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (TFA-92585 attachment, 2026-09-25), the app's task screens, the task screens' code (TasksOverlay, routes/snf/Tasks, tasksExport, handoffs send), convex/email.ts and the built bundle

When Compare layout, grouping, labels, completed section and Copy Text output side by side; review what Copy Text and Send can call; watch network requests while pressing them

Then Matches the prototype; the prototype's Email Tasks is absent in the app (AC 11 wins); Send, the visit on completed tasks and the completed grouping are judged against the AC text and the current app UI (Q13). No mailto, email-send action, Web Share or Capacitor Share is reachable from the task screens; convex/email.ts only sends sign-in codes; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Human side-by-side review (AC 1) and code + HAR review (AC 11 'confirmed absent, not just unused')

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method CODEREVIEW · Code review; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from unknown to broken.

Issue type: Ticket not ready for QA · environment local · tickets TFA-92585 ready for qa; TFA-92586 ready for qa

Email Tasks is really gone (only Copy Text, and no email path for tasks), but the task screen has no Send button for handing the list to a covering physician.

Send lives in PR #106 (not merged), with TFA-92585 and 92586 both ready for pr. Q13 (Daniela) decides whether Send is judged against the current UI. The p72 side-by-side and the HAR capture were not run.
